what: [performance] An order package with NO linked trade reads `accountClass: real_money` / `isDemo: false` on GET /api/bot/order-packages. MEASURED 2026-10-04 (endpoint read with include_paper=true): pkg-389f8c6f3dd84347 and pkg-f8e7b3df361b4951 (pairs_bnb_btc_a, status orphaned, orphaned_reason 'BUG-049 -- no linked_trade_id after 5 min; package was never executed') both render real_money although config/pairs.yaml routes every pairs leg to bybit_1 (paper) and no real-money account rosters a pairs leg. CAUSE (src/web/api/routers/order_packages.py, the SELECT): `COALESCE(t.is_demo, 0) AS trade_is_demo` on a LEFT JOIN that found no trade, then `_account_class_wire(None, 0)` -> real_money. This is the 'we did not look' -> 'real money' collapse CLAUDE.md § Three things forbids, on the surface the Decisions tab and this review's real_money split read. FIX (Tier-1, read path): when `t.id IS NULL`, emit `accountClass: null` plus `accountClassReadState: 'no_linked_trade'` (or derive from the strategy's declared account roster in config/accounts.yaml), and register the three-way state with collapsed-state-guard; add a test with an orphaned package.
